messages.subject: Newbie: Converting Variable type from Integer to Factor
parts:
Hi all,
I am very new to R and Deducer so just learning the functionality. I imported a dataset that has one column named "Sex" and it is interpreted by Deducer as an Integer with either a "1" or a "2".  I wanted to convert the data type from Integer to Factor, and specify 1 = Female, 2 = Male.  When I try to do this in the Variable View, all data in the column becomes NA. 

What am I doing wrong?  Can you convert?

Thank-you
